title: Strengthening County Health Supply Chains in Kenya
author: Dr. Amina Omondi, Nairobi Hub Lead
summary: We partnered with the Ministry of Health to optimize last-mile pharmaceutical logistics across 10 counties, reducing clinic stock-outs by 40%.
content: Our resident technical assistance team worked directly inside county health executive offices to establish real-time digital inventory tracking. By connecting rural dispensaries with central medical stores, we cut stock-out duration for essential maternal medicines from 45 days to under 6 days.
highlights: Real-Time Digital Supply Chain Dashboard Implemented

title: Direct Climate Adaptation Finance for Pastoralist Communities
author: Kwame Mensah, Adaptation Finance Advisor
summary: Directing international climate adaptation funds to community-led pastoralist groups increases project longevity by 40%.
content: In partnership with county climate change committees, Built on Site designed localized risk transfer mechanisms and community-managed water retention funds in Northern Kenya and Ethiopia. This decentralized governance structure ensured 92% of funds reached target pastoralist households directly.

title: Co-Designing Kenya's National Social Protection Policy
author: Grace Wambui, Senior Policy Analyst
summary: Providing embedded legal and economic drafting assistance to line ministries to expand social safety net coverage.
content: Over 18 months, our resident policy team embedded within the Ministry of Labour and Social Protection to co-draft legislative frameworks and cash transfer guidelines targeting vulnerable households across Kenya.
highlights: Expanded Cash Transfer Guidelines to 47 Counties
